title: 皮肤切换器 - Skin Changer
description:
[h1]皮肤切换器 - Skin Changer[/h1]

在选角界面、卡牌总览、单卡放大预览、怪物图鉴和远古图鉴中切换已安装的外观 Mod，无需重启游戏。

[b]主要功能[/b]
[list]
[*]角色、卡牌、怪物和远古者皮肤即时切换
[*]每张卡牌可单独选择卡图及配套卡框/布局
[*]怪物皮肤可按“怪物 + 皮肤”独立调整 50%–200% 缩放
[*]自动隔离纯外观 Mod 的强制补丁，避免未选择的皮肤占用资源
[*]设置自动保存；未设置时优先使用第一个非原版皮肤
[/list]

[b]使用提示[/b]
请将本 Mod 放在加载顺序第一位，以便完整接管皮肤资源。若未置顶，游戏内会显示提示，并可一键置顶后重启。

仅管理玩家已经安装并启用的皮肤 Mod，本 Mod 自身不包含第三方皮肤资源。

当前版本：0.9.29
源代码：https://github.com/gurio-wine/STS2-SkinChanger

[h1]English[/h1]
Switch installed cosmetic mods from character select, the card compendium, enlarged card previews, the monster compendium, and the Ancient compendium without restarting the game.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Hot-swap character, card, monster, and Ancient skins
[*]Per-card art selection with matching frames and layouts
[*]Per monster-and-skin scale control from 50% to 200%
[*]Isolates forced cosmetic patches so unselected skins cannot take over resources
[*]Persistent selections with a non-vanilla skin preferred by default
[/list]

Place this mod first in the load order so it can manage cosmetic resources consistently. The in-game warning can move it to the top and restart automatically.

This manager does not bundle third-party skin assets; install and enable the skin mods you want to use separately.

Version: 0.9.29
Source: https://github.com/gurio-wine/STS2-SkinChanger
